title: The Actuarial Scuttle
logline: An apprentice claims adjuster investigates an insured ore tug disabled in deep space, discovering the dying skipper vented his own drive core to trigger a payout.

roles.description: An apprentice claims adjuster on their first solo field assignment, terrified of approving a fraudulent total-loss payout.
An aging bulk hauler skipper drowning in medical debt who deliberately vented his own drive core to trigger an insurance settlement.
Holds the mortgage on the hauler's reactor and sits in the station lounge waiting to claim the payout.
A listing, venting ore tug tethered to an outer mooring pylon with its thrusters blown outward.
A cramped mutual underwriting agency office smelling of stale tea and damp thermal paper.

public_situation: An ore tug drifts outside {system}'s primary depot while underwriters debate whether a breached reactor qualifies as an insurable total loss.
private_truth: {role:tug_skipper} deliberately breached the primary cooling lines to secure a terminal-care payout before syndicate loans came due.

beats.public_change: Depot authorities post hazard warnings around the listing hulk of {role:scuttled_tug}.

missions.reason: The apprentice adjuster needs thermal imaging of the ruptured reactor casing to confirm whether damage originated from external impacts or an internal scuttle valve.
missions.private_fact: The apprentice faces dismissal if their first certified field report approves an unsubstantiated total-loss settlement.

beats.public_change: Creditors arrive at the dock demanding custody of the tug's physical flight computer.

missions.reason: The skipper asks the pilot to retrieve his sealed navigation recorder from the damaged cockpit before station marshals seize the vessel.
missions.private_fact: The skipper uploaded encrypted spoofing scripts into the core to disguise the manual emergency scuttle sequence.

beats.public_change: {role:syndicate_creditor} files an emergency lien freezing the skipper's medical accounts pending claim resolution.

missions.reason: The apprentice asks the pilot to courier the decrypted recorder analysis to the underwriting desk to reach a final binding claim decision.
missions.private_fact: The apprentice already suspects deliberate fraud but fears the creditor will murder the dying skipper if the policy lapses.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds proof that the skipper scuttled his own ship to clear debts and fund terminal care. The apprentice adjuster awaits the decision.

options.label: Sanitize the telemetry so the apprentice certifies a valid total loss, paying the skipper and satisfying creditors
Present the raw telemetry to underwriters, voiding the claim and protecting the apprentice's career
Persuade the creditor to accept the tug hulk as scrap settlement in exchange for forgiving the skipper's note

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sanitizes the scuttle telemetry and certifies total loss.
resolutions.summary: Underwriters pay out the total-loss claim; {role:syndicate_creditor} receives full debt satisfaction while {role:tug_skipper} enters private hospice.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped an apprentice adjuster approve a dying hauler's suspicious insurance claim.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot presents raw scuttle logs to underwriters, exposing the fraud.
resolutions.summary: The claim is rejected for intentional scuttling; {role:junior_adjuster} is commended while {role:tug_skipper} is jailed under crushing debt liens.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a scrap transfer to satisfy the creditor.
resolutions.summary: {role:syndicate_creditor} accepts ownership of {role:scuttled_tug} for salvage scrap, clearing the note while the insurance inquiry is quietly closed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot drops the contracts or telemetry is lost.
resolutions.summary: {role:scuttled_tug} breaks from its mooring and drifts into the exclusion zone; the claim lapses and {role:tug_skipper} is arrested for navigational neglect.

loose_threads.detail: The tug insurance policy contains a newly added rider assigning total loss proceeds to an anonymous off-world holding desk.
The scuttled tug flight harness has severed umbilical leads cut cleanly with standard pneumatic wire shears.

radio_hooks: Salvage crews monitor drifting ore tug outside {system} primary shipping approach.
Underwriting board delays casualty payout pending forensic inspection of cooling breach.
Dockside lenders issue formal liens against aging freight haulers across the sector.

voice_direction.junior_adjuster: Nervous, meticulous, reading regulatory paragraphs verbatim while hesitating before answering direct questions.
voice_direction.tug_skipper: Raspy, weary, speaking in short breaths and treating the loss of his livelihood with bitter, exhausted calm.
voice_direction.syndicate_creditor: Smooth, intimidating, speaking with relaxed menace and treating financial foreclosures as pleasant business lunches.
